_what: Policy-floor values: the numbers the typed lift reads that the floor's Cedar text cannot hold. This file is part of the floor bundle; its digest is recorded with the floor's and the schema's (ADR-0039 §1). Relaxing a value is an anchor issuance and a promotion; tightening is an ordinary promotion.
_status: DRAFT · 2026.09.30 · PLACEHOLDERS · not ratified · not measured
_placeholders: Every number here is a placeholder chosen so the ratification runs have a value. None is measured. Each is a deployment or rung choice, declared per deployment under ADR-0023 §6, and the archetype does not fix it. Do not cite these as the pattern's values.

observer._T_obs: Heartbeat freshness, read on the mechanism's local monotonic clock with its asymmetric margin (ADR-0032 §2; the reference's lease_margin_ms). Placeholder: about five propagation windows W (ADR-0032 §4, ~1 s at the archetype), ten lease margins, and well inside a lease TTL. A deployment sets it from its Observer's measured heartbeat cadence.
observer._K: Unread bound: at most K of a Thinker's emissions unread by a live cell Observer. In Run the count is over effect-bearing admits, Actuate and Report, and not Consult (ADR-0042 §2, Proposed). Must be below the round bound R of every domain it applies to; the mechanism refuses a floor where it is not. Placeholder: T_obs at roughly one admit per second, rounded up. A deployment sets it from its Observer's measured lag; K = 0 is the quarantine hold (ADR-0039 finding 1).

persona._T_persona: Upper bound on a lease's ttl at grant and at every renewal, so the Persona is re-attested at least this often. Placeholder: one hour; a deployment sets it from its provider's declared cadence (ADR-0016 Context) and its renewal cost. Must exceed the lease margin and T_obs. Not yet read by the reference.

lineage._note: The θ values, β, and the near-duplicate tool are policy-floor values with the same home. They are set from measurements at training scale (G4 item 30), not before; null means not set, and the independence table is not computed while any is null.
